# Phase Three — Final Execution Covenant

The Awtsmoos recreates the river before a single pixel can flow;
Awtsmoos.com must therefore grant each behavior and selector one vessel, one owner, one glow.

## Final architecture

This pass chooses singular ownership over override warfare. Auto-scroll gets one shared scroll-root resolver. The post reader keeps route contracts but replaces active high-specificity CSS owners with scoped modules. The social app keeps its component/API graph but receives a stronger root-scoped glass vocabulary.

## Thirty-five final safeguards and revelations

1. Auto-scroll root resolution must be a pure discoverable function, not duplicated inside motion code.
2. A candidate inner root counts only when its computed overflow and scroll extent prove it can move.
3. Document fallback must continue working when the reader uses natural page scroll.
4. Read and write methods must target the same resolved root during a session.
5. Viewport height must come from the owning root, not always `window.innerHeight`.
6. Max scroll must use the same root used for movement.
7. Smooth-scroll suppression must restore the exact previous inline value.
8. No JS call may pass CSS priority `important`.
9. The floating auto-scroll control may have one geometry owner only.
10. The A/I floating controls may have one geometry owner only.
11. The settings sheet may have one fixed-position owner only.
12. Direct-loaded critical CSS may establish visibility and containment, not theme duplication.
13. Mobile-reading CSS may own narrow-screen reading density, not duplicate floating-control placement.
14. Scroll-root CSS may own only scroll topology.
15. Settings shell may own panel geometry and glass, not child controls.
16. Settings groups may own grouping rhythm and hierarchy.
17. Settings controls may own buttons, inputs, selects, toggles, focus, hover, active, and disabled states.
18. Settings flow may own auto-scroll status/readout/range presentation.
19. Action rail must be split into rail geometry, control appearance, and runtime states.
20. Every new CSS child module stays below 120 lines.
21. Existing oversized action CSS becomes a small import vessel instead of remaining a monolith.
22. Reader social shell must stop restating scroll topology that belongs to scroll-root.
23. Discussion CSS may own comment/community cards and retry surfaces only.
24. Error UI must remain semantically honest; glass cannot turn transport failure into fake emptiness.
25. The community endpoint is changed only after direct runtime evidence proves route mismatch or server failure.
26. Social tokens must expose depth, glow, motion, and state colors so child modules do not hard-code competing palettes.
27. Social base may own ambient layers and universal local interactions only.
28. Social layout may own shell topology and responsive rail behavior only.
29. Social feed may own post-card composition and card-local interaction only.
30. Keyboard focus must remain at least as visible as pointer hover.
31. Motion must disable or collapse under `prefers-reduced-motion` without selector escalation.
32. Touch controls must remain at least 44px in the reader and social surfaces.
33. iOS safe-area insets must be consumed at floating and sheet edges.
34. Active CSS import closure must be scanned after rewrites; any surviving `!important` in loaded owner files becomes new work.
35. Completion requires browser-observed movement, modal usability, social rendering, console cleanliness, and a final plan-vs-actual readback.

## Verification graph

Implementation -> full readback -> syntax checks -> CSS active-closure scan -> auto-scroll unit tests -> existing social contract suite -> local server discovery -> mobile browser post -> auto-scroll movement measurement -> Scribe's Lens interaction -> Main Menu interaction -> community endpoint fetch -> social demo mobile/desktop -> console/log review -> delta document.

## Browser acceptance criteria

- At approximately 390px width, no floating control overlaps the primary settings sheet or menu action space.
- Auto-scroll toggle visibly changes state and the actual owning scroll root advances after start.
- Pause/stop prevents continued movement.
- Scribe's Lens is internally scrollable, safe-area aware, and every visible control remains reachable.
- Main Menu cards have coherent hover/focus/press behavior where the device supports it.
- Community retry state is polished but still reports an actual transport failure honestly.
- Social feed cards show glass depth, ambient motion, focus-within clarity, and reduced-motion safety.
- Desktop retains readable maximum widths and does not inherit mobile fixed geometry.

## REMAINING_WORK

- Re-read exact target files before overwriting to preserve public selectors.
- Implement auto-scroll root resolver and adapter.
- Implement reader CSS ownership rewrite.
- Implement social CSS intensification.
- Scan active import closure for remaining `!important` and eliminate loaded conflicts.
- Run static/unit/contract tests.
- Discover/start runtime and verify community transport.
- Browser verify post and social views.
- Re-read all changed files and write planned-vs-actual delta.
- Resolve every discovered regression before final handoff.

## NEXT_ACTION

Read the final target owners in compact groups, then execute full-file writes beginning with auto-scroll behavior.
